title: Auto-AdvER: annotated car-advertisement corpus, guidelines, model predictions and code
description:
Auto-AdvER is a span-labelling schema and corpus for the textual car-advertisement domain: 605 UK car adverts, half written by motor traders and half by private sellers, annotated with three labels, Condition, Historic and Sales Options. This record archives a tagged release of the GitHub repository. It contains the corpus with character-offset spans and a word-level IOB2 view, the three cross-validation folds used in the paper, the inter-annotator-agreement study with three pseudonymised annotators, the annotation guidelines, the stored predictions of every model configuration reported in the paper together with the scorer that regenerates the paper's tables from them.

Licences: the data (data/), the stored predictions (predictions/) and the annotation guidelines (guidelines/) are released under CC BY 4.0; the code (src/, tests/, results/make_tables.py, configs/) under the MIT Licence. The repository README gives the schema, the provenance and anonymisation statement, the notes for reproduction and the citation.

Developed with the Autotrader Research Group, Autotrader UK.
